info.title: Factigent UMS API
info.description:
# About Factigent UMS
Factigent UMS manages users, profiles, roles, permissions, groups, organizations, and module-level access.

## Integration guidance
- Use the discovery endpoints before creating dependent resources.
- Runtime scope and role headers are gateway-managed; do not invent them in an LLM.
- Examples show payload shape only. Replace identifiers and placeholders with valid runtime values.
- Login payload examples intentionally use a placeholder password.
